newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Probe says Siberia oil well producing.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Probe says Siberia oil well producing.

text.p: Probe Resources NL said on Friday that the Mokhtikovskoye oil field in western Siberia has been commissioned and that field output from the first six wells was 1,200 barrels of oil a day.
Probe is set to acquire a 50 percent interest in Mokhtikovskoye through its planned acquisition of Irish firm Minpetro Global Resources Ltd, Probe official said.
The remaining 50 percent is held by Russia's Siboil group.
Oil from the field is being stored prior to the sale of the first shipment, Probe said.
Probe company secretary Rowan Clark told Reuters that Probe expects to relist on the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) in about 10 days, following its acquisition of Minpetro.
Probe was delisted from the ASX in March 1996 after announcing a change in the company's direction.
